From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace@redwood.com>

Subject: Stage-gate "Lighthouse" review: instructions & deliverables

Team —

Quick heads-up: finance is running a tighter stage-gate for next week’s leadership review. I’m calling this the "Lighthouse" pass — focused on deals we plan to present in the QBR leadership packet. Goals: ensure committed ARR is accurate, highlight any material blockers, and confirm owner-level readiness for exec questions.

Action items (please read):
- One-line ask: populate the attached stage_updates_template.csv with final stage, ARR, close date, gating risk (Low/Med/High), and the owner’s one-sentence mitigation plan.
- Use the Lighthouse checklist (attached) to verify decks: primary metric, backup ask, and fallback model.
- Drop your completed row in the shared sheet (link below) by Monday 24 Aug 17:00 PT. If you can’t meet that, flag ETA in-thread and assign a single lead for your region.

Why this matters: leadership pack assembly starts Tue 25 Aug — late entries cascade into poor SLAs on pricing/finance signoff. We need clean inputs to avoid surprises during the exec review.

Attachments: stage_updates_template.csv, lighthouse_checklist.pdf
Shared sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDEFGHIjKLmnoPqR/view
HubSpot: HS-44127

Thanks — please reply with your regional lead if you’re not the owner.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

> 
> Quick heads-up: finance is running a tighter stage-gate for next week’s leadership review...

Thanks Karthik — I’ll take EMEA as the regional lead for this pass. Two quick clarifications:
1) For "close date" do you want committed close date or contract signature date?
2) Should we include deals that were previously marked "churned/rescoped" but may re-enter the pipeline?

Laura
Laura Bennett
Manager, Sales Operations
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: markus_klein <markus@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate "Lighthouse" review: instructions & deliverables

Laura —
Short answers:
- Use "contract signature date" as the close date column (that aligns with finance recognition).
- Exclude deals marked churned/rescoped unless there is an owner-attested reactivation plan and a visible PO/renewal commitment. If you include one of those, mark it "At-Risk-Reactivation" in the notes column.

Thanks for stepping up on EMEA. Please add a single EMEA contact to the first row so the pack engine can call them out in the deck.

Karthik
